title: Analysis code and derived results for: Global, regional, and national burden of early-onset cancer and its metabolic-risk-attributable fraction, 1990–2023
description:
Analysis code, exact GBD Results Tool query definitions, and derived result tables for a systematic analysis of early-onset cancer (ages 15–49) and its metabolic-risk-attributable fraction using GBD 2023 (release 8352), including within-band direct age standardisation, joinpoint and age–period–cohort models, decomposition, inequality indices, 2050 scenarios, detection-effect exclusion, Newey–West inference, a GLOBOCAN 2024 external benchmark, and a site × sex decomposition.

Raw GBD and GLOBOCAN extracts are not redistributed because of the IHME and IARC terms of use; the query definitions reproduce the GBD inputs. Code is released under the MIT License; derived result tables under CC BY 4.0.
notes: Derived tables in results/ are released under CC BY 4.0. GBD 2023 and GLOBOCAN 2024 estimates remain subject to the IHME and IARC terms of use.
